based_on.note: Endpoint definition and tick hard cap are copied from the frozen #99 control plan and must not change to chase a reproduction number.

mode_switch.gates: lifecycle persistence adapter only (lifecycle-events.jsonl plus close receipt)
mode_switch.not_gated: the ZombieInitialize probe and the legacy lvz.spawn.v1 projection are installed by the audit host in both modes

modes.name: off
modes.purpose: manifest declares lifecycle capability enabled=false and no lifecycle file exists

modes.name: on
modes.purpose: lifecycle persistence enabled; lifecycle-events.jsonl plus atomic close receipt

limitations: off/on cannot measure instrumented-vs-uninstrumented gameplay because the probe is installed in both modes
a true instrumentation off/on comparison needs a separate build without the probe (new build identity); no build-time switch exists
death/removal/recycle facts are not covered by either mode until those capture points pass the candidate-review gate
mode_switch.comparison_rule: Compare common evidence only (boundary state deltas, checksums, RNG, actions, outcomes). The lifecycle_recording capability block and lifecycle files are mode metadata and are excluded from gameplay comparison.

evaluation_child_mapping.note: Each name is one evaluation suite; run_suite creates these child directories (seed 42, cold_starts=1). They are child runs of a suite, not four separate trajectories.

comparisons.name: control_repeatability
comparisons.require: common boundary/state/RNG/action equality within the frozen window

comparisons.name: mode_repeatability
comparisons.require: common boundary/state/RNG/action equality plus valid lifecycle receipt in every on child run

comparisons.name: persistence_adapter_non_perturbation
comparisons.require: first divergence located and reported on common evidence; not a pass/fail on event-stream difference alone; the probe is present in both modes

comparisons.name: tick940_unknown_path
comparisons.require: scan the whole declared window for removed-without-death-stage entities and report coordinates; must not assume 33 objects; capture-level claims stay unavailable without reviewed death/removal hooks

verdicts: capture completeness: valid lifecycle receipts plus strict closed audit for every expected child run; death/removal capture is unavailable until the candidate-review gate closes
persistence-adapter non-perturbation (never instrumentation non-perturbation): common evidence equality or first divergence with range
two-run repeatability: on-a children vs on-b children on common evidence
first-kill sufficiency: reported by tools/issue111_lifecycle_report.py; false while death/removal capture points are missing
forbidden: overwriting or modifying the four issue #99 trajectories, reports or seals
starting more than one game process at a time
changing stop_when, tick_budget or the declared endpoint after seeing results
installing death/removal/recycle hooks before the candidate-review gate closes
claiming instrumentation off/on from the persistence switch
treating event-stream differences alone as an instrumentation failure or as a gameplay fork
claiming a full-window first kill without death/removal capture and call-internal ordering
required_reviews: maintainer review of docs/issue111-原生候选证据.md before any death/removal/recycle production hook
maintainer acceptance that stage D may run with only the merged initialization probe if the candidate gate is still open; the tick-940 investigation then reports unavailable at capture level
